lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba8Cd4As4S16 (reduced formula Ba2CdAsS4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral As and S environments, with As centers coordinated by four S neighbors and S centers by one As and three Cd neighbors; Cd centers show 10 geometric neighbors (six Ba, four S). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 32 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reports corner-sharing between As and S tetrahedra and between Cd and S polyhedra, plus corner-sharing among Cd polyhedra.
